html:
-- Skill name -> skill ID, for the hover boxes of the Special Skills on glider cards.
-- Fill in the numbers and remove the "--" in front of each line you have an ID for.
-- The ID is the number in https://aa-classic.com/data/skills/<id>.json
-- A glider skill that is not active here is shown as plain coloured text without a hover box.
-- The name must be written exactly like in the glider's description (capital letters count).
-- Found by checking the descriptions of the glider and magithopter items (names in the comments).
return {
	 ['Acorn Bomb'] = 8000163,   -- Squirrel Glider Companion
	 ['Ascending Stunt'] = 8000204,   -- Skywhisper Glider
	 ['Backward Roll'] = 24326,   -- Sloth Glider Companion
	 ['Bombard'] = 13430,   -- Thunderbolt Glider
	 ['Breeze On By'] = 8001543,   -- Cumulus Magithopter
	 ['Broomaneuver'] = 8001041,   -- Stormduster 1000
	 ['Crystal Trail'] = 38130,   -- Crystal Wings
	 ['Descending Stunt'] = 8000205,   -- Skywhisper Glider
	 ['Divebomb'] = 53001,   -- Red Dragon Glider, Rocket Wings #2, Blood-Stained Flower Wings

	 ['Forward Ho!'] = 32475,   -- Panda Glider Companion

	 ['Glider Charge'] = 8000703,   -- Flamefeather Glider, Nightfire Glider, Phoenix Glider
	 ['Glider Descent'] = 21297,   -- Gilded Royal Glider, Imperial Jade Wing, Heir's Glider
	 ['Glider Nitro'] = 23040,   -- Cloudrun Glider
	 ['Go Away!'] = 43618,   -- Mirage Broom
	 ['Instant Acceleration'] = 8000704,   -- Flamefeather Glider, Nightfire Glider, Phoenix Glider, Marauder's Glider
	 ['Invincible Flight'] = 8000327,   -- Ezi's Glider
	 ['Lovely Heart'] = 50472,   -- Arkana Wings: Heart
	 ['Lucky Clover'] = 50473,   -- Arkana Wings: Clover
	 ['Mutually-Assured Destruction'] = 36952,   -- Rocket Wings
	 ['Nebe`s Stealth'] = 46477,   -- Nebe`s Favor Magithopter
	 ['Quick Turn Left'] = 8000427,   -- Marauder's Glider
	 ['Quick Turn Right'] = 8000428,   -- Marauder's Glider
	 ['Ragebolt'] = 35649,   -- Titan's Wings
	 ['Rocket Charge'] = 36950,   -- Rocket Wings
	 ['Rocket Launch'] = 8001354,   -- Rocket Wings #2
	 ['Shadow Flight'] = 8000332,   -- Moonshadow Glider
	 ['Shelling Support'] = 43268,   -- Triple Engine Hot Air Balloon
	 ['Slow Down'] = 43617,   -- Mirage Broom
	 ['Snowflake Flight'] = 48549,   -- Snowflake Wings
	 ['Somersault (Left)'] = 19331,   -- Dawnbreak Dove, Feathered Hope, Gilt Spiral Glider, Glass Phoenix, Pure/Loving/Corrupt Ally's Wings, Crimson/Lapis Fae Wing
     ['Somersault (Right)'] = 19167,   -- Dawnbreak Dove, Feathered Hope, Gilt Spiral Glider, Glass Phoenix, Pure/Loving/Corrupt Ally's Wings, Crimson/Lapis Fae Wing
	 ['Spade Sword'] = 50449,   -- Arkana Wings: Spade

	 ['Stealthy Sweeper'] = 8001042,   -- Stormduster 1000

	 ['Teleport Left'] = 8000646,   -- Astra Wings
